argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.11-12.1: Present precise knowledgeable claims and their significance; sequence claims/counterclaims/reasons/evidence; develop both thoroughly and fairly with strongest relevant evidence and limitations, anticipating audience values/biases; use varied syntax, formal objective tone and a fitting conclusion.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.11-12.1: Apply standard grammar while recognizing disputed/changing usage and consulting references when needed.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.11-12.2: Use appropriate hyphenation and correct spelling/capitalization.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.11-12.3: Vary syntax for effect with understanding of complex syntax.

informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.11-12.2: Build complex ideas into a unified whole with significant relevant evidence for the audience; use varied transitions/syntax and precise domain language or explanatory comparisons, formal objective tone and a conclusion addressing implications.
informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.11-12.1: Apply standard grammar while recognizing disputed/changing usage and consulting references when needed.
informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.11-12.2: Use appropriate hyphenation and correct spelling/capitalization.
informative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.11-12.3: Vary syntax for effect with understanding of complex syntax.

narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.11-12.3: Establish a significant problem/situation/observation and perspective(s); use narrative techniques and sequencing to build coherence, tone and outcome; use vivid details and conclude reflectively.

narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.11-12.2: Use appropriate hyphenation and correct spelling/capitalization.
narrative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.11-12.3: Vary syntax for effect with understanding of complex syntax.
